description: Template for the 15-20 question hand-built evaluation set from Project 1, Lesson 6 (Evaluation & Tuning). Copy this structure, replace the example rows with real questions against your own document set, and keep expected_source pointing at the exact file path your Lesson 4 chunker would record in chunk metadata.
instructions: Each item needs a question, an expected_answer (or a short summary of what a correct answer must say), and an expected_source (the file path you know contains the answer).
Aim for 15-20 items covering a mix of single-fact lookups and questions that require combining two or more chunks.
Run recall@k first (do the correct sources come back at all), then LLM-as-judge scoring on generation quality, per Lesson 6.
Re-run both measurements after every tuning change and record the before/after numbers in your README.

eval_set.question: Example: What is the default timeout for a request in this library?
eval_set.expected_answer: Example: 5 seconds, unless overridden by the timeout parameter.

eval_set.question: Example: How do I configure retry behavior and what's the default retry count?
eval_set.expected_answer: Example: Retries are configured via the retries parameter; the default is 0 (no automatic retries).

eval_set.question: Example: If I set both a custom timeout and a custom retry count, which configuration section covers both and do they interact?
eval_set.expected_answer: Example: Both are documented in the client configuration section; a retried request reuses the same timeout for each attempt.
